name: comp-596
title: Nav Switch Header
description: A flat dark monitoring header with Overview, Graphs and Backups links, thin badges for online status, 99.9% and 45ms, and a two-tone power toggle at the far right.
use: A service dashboard needs health metrics and a power toggle pinned to the top.
avoid: The switch only flips local state, and the online and latency figures are fixed text.
a11y: The power switch has screen-reader text, but nothing explains what turning power off does and there is no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A flat dark header with Overview, Graphs and Backups links, the first underlined in white, then three thin outline badges: Online with a green dot, 99.9% with a lightning bolt and 45ms with a clock. At the far right a two-tone pill holds power icons.
behaves: Hovering a nav link draws an underline along its bottom edge and hover tints the badges. Clicking the pill slides its white half from one power icon to the other to switch the state.
customise: Nav labels, badge values and the default switch state are written in the file; the online badge colour is hardcoded green.
weight: light: Three links, three badges and one switch.
